name: @corbits-builder/coder
description: Builds the project's code the first time, whatever kind of thing it is, and changes the code the project has, built here or imported.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The project's code needs building for the first time, or the person asks for a change to the code the project has.
builder.unless: The person is still unsure what they want and would rather compare options or see a mockup first.

build.when: The project has no code yet and its requirements or build plan say what to build.
build.unless: The project already has code; a change to it is coder change.

change.when: The person asks for a change to the code the project already has, built here or imported: a fix, an addition or a correction.
change.unless: The project has no code yet, or the person is still unsure what they want and would rather compare options first.

builds.when: Before showing, filing or deploying the project's code, to prove its saved version still builds.

examples: add a flag that prints the version

facts.app_exists: the project has code, built or imported
facts.!app_exists: the project has no code yet

stack.language.about: The programming language the project's code is written in, such as TypeScript.

stack.starter.about: What the project's code started from: web-app for a web app with a browser client and a server, bare for anything else. Builder saves it when the first build starts.

web-app.about: A web app people use in a browser: a React client, a Bun server and a shared package, finished when check-app passes.

bare.about: Anything that is not a web app, such as a command-line tool, a library, a script or a service: one TypeScript package on Bun with tests and no framework, finished when check-project passes.
